extracted_rows.q: Have you ever seen a jerboa?
extracted_rows.a: It lives in the desert in Palestine. It is small. It looks like a small mouse. It comes out at night time.

extracted_rows.q: Have you ever seen a gazelle?
extracted_rows.a: It lives in the desert in Palestine. It is big. It does not like people. It runs away.
